metadata.description: Russian-language STT evaluation cases for Russian-only ASR models. The cases cover everyday dictation, work context, technical terms, numbers, dates, names, and punctuation-like phrasing.

categories.technical: Technical words, product names, and mixed Latin/Cyrillic terms
